acceptance: The warning measures time since a run started, or ignores a run that is waiting behind one in flight, and a test covers a waiting run older than 30 minutes
A run that has really stalled after starting is still reported
context: Left unchanged on purpose in the Trunk latest-head change; recorded in the decision note _project/decisions/trunk-latest-head-runs-2026-10-30.md. Not yet observed to mislead anyone.
description: scripts/trunk_revert.py stale_run_warning flags a develop run after 30 minutes. With one Trunk run in flight at a time, a waiting run can sit longer than that behind a healthy, long run, so the warning can fire when nothing is wrong.
